items.Sentence: The tertiary treatment process with granular media filtration is capable of reliably meeting a turbidity limitation of 2 NTU as a daily average.
The tertiary treatment process with membrane filtration is capable of reliably meeting a turbidity limitation of 0.2 NTU more than 5 percent of the time within a 24-hour period, respectively.
Failure of the treatment system such that virus removal is impaired would normally result in increased particles in the effluent, which result in higher effluent turbidity and could impact UV dosage.
